architecture.pages: Route-level functional React components grouped by feature (Clubs, Events, Chats, Admin).
architecture.context: Global state managers, mainly handling user authentication logic and session storage.
architecture.services: Centralized API layers segregating standard HTTP requests and real-time socket events.
architecture.routes: Navigation security implementations preventing unauthorized access to specific areas.

steps: Unauthenticated user lands on '/' and is redirected to '/login'.
User signs in via '/login' or creates an account via '/register'.
Upon success, AuthContext registers the session, and user is redirected to the protected application shell.
User arrives at '/dashboard' (rendered inside the AppLayout shell) to see a personalized feed or overview.
User can access their profile at '/profile' to update their details.
User can view bookmarked clubs or events at '/bookmarks'.
User browses all available campus clubs at '/clubs'.
User reviews clubs they manage or have joined at '/my-clubs'.
User can initiate a club creation request via '/clubs/create'.
User views in-depth details, members, and posts of a specific club at '/clubs/:id'.
Club admins can modify the club settings at '/clubs/:id/edit'.
Club admins organize internal club events via '/events/create' and modify them at '/events/:id/edit'.
Users explore broader campus/external events at '/external-events'.
Users can submit an external event for approval via '/external-events/create'.
Detailed views for internal and external events are available at '/events/:id' and '/external-events/:id' respectively.
User navigates to '/chats' to see their active conversations/club groups.
User enters a specific room at '/chats/:id' where chatSocket.js establishes a WebSocket connection for real-time messaging.
System administrators enter '/admin' for an overview.
Admins moderate the platform by verifying submitted external events at '/admin/verify'.
Admins analyze user activity and platform metrics at '/admin/stats'.

root.App.jsx: The highest-level component defining all application routes. It wraps the router in the AuthProvider and uses AppLayout for all protected paths.
root.App.css: Global layout shifts and base application styling.
root.index.css: Base typography, color variables, and CSS resets.

components.AppLayout.jsx: The structural wrapper for authenticated users, typically containing the Sidebar/Navbar and the <Outlet /> for rendering nested page content.

context.AuthContext.jsx: React Context provider containing the state for the currently logged-in user, managing login/logout functions and JWT token validation.

services.api.js: Axios/Fetch utility configuring base URLs and interceptors (e.g., automatically attaching Bearer tokens to headers) for REST requests.
services.chatApi.js: Dedicated API service for fetching chat histories, creating rooms, and managing chat participants via standard HTTP.
services.chatSocket.js: WebSocket setup (e.g., socket.io-client) used to emit and listen to live events like 'message_received' or 'typing' for real-time functionality.

routes.ProtectedRoute.jsx: A wrapper component safeguarding authenticated routes. It checks the AuthContext and redirects unauthenticated users back to '/login'.

use_cases.description: Students easily discover and engage with university clubs and organizations in a central hub.
Empowers club leaders to manage their own events internally, while also allowing generalized external events to be showcased to the whole campus.
Provides dedicated, real-time chat rooms for club members to coordinate and interact seamlessly.
Equips the administration with a verify step for external events to ensure platform content remains relevant and appropriate.
